research_experience.title: Graduate Research Projects
responsibilities: Collaborating with Dominic Kao on frozen LLM player-action prediction, survey-linked behavioral measures of embodiment, and AI-assistant awareness, warmth, and eeriness.
Contributing Unity/C# study development and telemetry validation for the Hatched/Waddle penguin perspective study.
Contributing literature screening, full-text review, and evidence synthesis to an avatar-color scoping review.

research_experience.title: Machine Learning Researcher in Behavioral Modeling
responsibilities: Developed temporal features and supervised models from movement and interaction telemetry across 7,000+ VR sessions to study task performance and early quitting.
Evaluated robustness under time-based and cross-game splits to approximate new-player populations, showing moderate but meaningful generalization across deployments and titles.
Applied SHAP-based feature attribution to surface interpretable movement patterns linked to quitting (e.g., oscillatory searching, frozen gaze), informing a TVCG submission on early-quit prediction.

Translated the model findings into a proposed, testable product intervention with a primary success metric, guardrail metrics, and a triggered randomized evaluation plan; the intervention has not yet been deployed.

research_experience.title: Undergraduate Researcher
responsibilities: Prototyped and iterated a one-on-one VR environment (Beyond the Garden of Adrian) in Unity (C#), investigated factors in design that shape player-actor interaction.
Surveyed 30+ participants to study transformational VR gameplay and the relationships among environment, actor, and audience; the updated work was accepted to the Festival d'Avignon.

research_experience.title: Undergraduate Researcher
responsibilities: Trained a deep neural network to identify Red Clump stars, addressing limitations of traditional observation pipelines.

Provided computational evidence supporting a correlation between Red Clump stars and galactic bars; used bar structures to probe Milky Way density and evaluate N-body simulations against observations.

research_experience.title: Undergraduate Researcher

Designed and implemented optimization routines in Java for partially observable Markov games.
Developed and visualized an exact POMG solver (belief-state discretization; iterative elimination of dominated strategies).
